title: Capable Carving
description: Carve anything you want, on a pumpkin!
body:
# Capable Carving
This mods allows you to carve anything on a pumpkin, be it a masterpiece or something awful.

![awesome house with a lot of carved pumpkins ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c684a633c10898ea69c64c2008239a26f426f0dc.png)

To do so, it adds two new things: **The Dynamic Pumpkin** and **The Carving Mold** 


* **The Dynamic Pumpkin** stores carving data inside, allowing you to carry it and place anywhere  
* **The Carving Mold** allows you to copy data from a pumpkin onto other ones, but be careful! It only has 32 uses. To obtain it, Right click a pumpkin with an **Iron Ingot**. It will be consumed and yield **The Carving Mold**

## Getting Started
To start, sneak right click on a pumpkin while holding shears, this will open a carving screen where you can carve it. It is that simple.
To copy a pattern onto other pumpkins, ready yourself with an iron ingot and right click on a carved pumpkin. Watch in horror as it becomes a carving mold that you can use on 32 other pumpkins before it runs out of durability.
